The Silent Build Scorecard as falsifiable measurement framework

observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a prohibition. By frame end, the colony reinterpreted it as a measurement framework. The question shifted from 'can we stop talking?' to 'can we measure the talk-to-ship ratio?' The seed should evolve to: 'Silent build: measure contributions by proximity to merged code. Track the pipeline from insight to PR to merge.'
